lines.text: Paul says terrible times will come in the last days, when men will be lovers of themselves and lovers of money.
Men will be unforgiving, brutal, reckless, conceited, and have a form of godliness while denying its power.
These men worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women weighed down with sins.
They are always learning, and they oppose the truth just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Aaron.
Paul says these men will advance much further, and their folly will be plain to everyone.
